facts.fact: Cameroon Tribune reports that the Minister of Public Contracts's communique of 7 April 2025 requires certain contracting authorities to pass all their contracts electronically through the Coleps platform, under an order of 27 December 2024 setting the migration calendar.
More than 8,143 public contracts worth 1,745 billion FCFA were programmed and published on Coleps for 2025 by January 2025, against 7,372 in 2024, the article says.
